description: DiligenceOps: submit SLA terms and an outage or service report, as text or as the month, outages, total downtime and stated uptime, with an optional monthly fee. The signed report works out the uptime exactly from the period minutes and the counted downtime (setting scheduled maintenance or degraded time apart when the terms exclude it), says whether the commitment was missed and by how many points, and names the credit band the terms prescribe with the credit percentage, any cap, the credit amount and the credit request deadline, each quoted. POST /api/sla-credit-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-vendor-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

currency.description: Currency or token code, for example USD, EUR or USDC.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

monthly_fee.description: Optional fee for the measured period, so the credit is worked out as an amount.

anyOf.description: The report as written, such as a status page history, incident report or monthly service report.

downtime_minutes.description: Total downtime in minutes, when the report gives a total.

month.description: The calendar month measured, for example "2026-10". Defaults to the period or the month of the first outage.

outages.description: Up to 200 outages with their start and end.

description.description: Optional account of the outage as the report states it.

ended_at.description: When it ended. A date alone ends at the start of that day.

kind.description: Optional kind. Maintenance is set apart when the terms exclude scheduled maintenance. Defaults to what the description says, else outage.

started_at.description: When the outage or incident began.

period.description: The measured period. A date end counts through the end of that day.

end.description: ISO date (2026-10-14) or datetime with a timezone (2026-10-14T09:12:00Z).

start.description: ISO date (2026-10-14) or datetime with a timezone (2026-10-14T09:12:00Z).

text.description: The report as written, read for outages, durations and a stated uptime when the fields are absent.

uptime_percent.description: The uptime the report states, compared with the uptime worked out from the outages.

report.description: The outage or service report, as text or as fields. Fields take precedence over the text.

report_label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

terms.description: The SLA terms: the uptime commitment, the service credit bands and any exclusions and credit request terms, up to 256 KB.

terms_label.description: Optional name for the material, recorded in the report.

name: wever_sla-credit-check
title: SLA credit check
